title: Player-facing route-tie caption renders at 11px — missed by the size audit
evidence:
caption := "equal cost - split by hash"
	fs := i32(max(11, s * 0.30))
	cw := i32(len(caption)) * fs / 2
	x := i32(c.x) - cw / 2
	y := i32(c.y - r - s * 0.36) - fs / 2
	draw_text_c(v, caption, x, y, fs, p.ink)
detail: Violates "nothing below ~14px effective at 1280×720" (spec AC). s = tile_px*scale = 24.0 at 1280×720, so 0.30*s = 7 -> the max(11,…) floor pins it at 11px at every window size. Player-facing: drawn whenever assist_mode != .Off (main.odin:336).
recommended_fix: Raise the caption floor to 14 (fs := i32(max(14, s * 0.30))), matching view.odin's telegraph glyph floor (max(14, s*0.5)).

title: Run hint still runs under the health card at the min clamp (all widths < ~1256px)
evidence: draw_text(app, "draw pipes; P / Space pauses; U previews upgrade", 12, 36, 14, p.ink_soft)  // health.odin:35/37/41: card_w := i32(440); x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2; rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, HEALTH_CARD_H, …)
detail: PR body: hints "clear the card's left edge at the min clamp too" and 1152 is "the narrowest width where the top band fits without overlap". Measured (bundled TTF, 14px + DrawTextEx spacing 1): hint = 386px, ends x=398; card left edge at 1152 = (1152-440)/2-10 = 346 — 52px under, for every width < 1256.
recommended_fix: Shorten the hint to ≤ ~42 chars (~330px), e.g. "draw pipes; P pauses; U previews upgrade", or raise MIN_WIN_W so the hint clears the card.

title: Bottom-right mode label (and nudge) overlaps the hardware tray for widths < ~1256px, including the min clamp
evidence: draw_text(app, mode_label, app.view.win_w - 320, app.view.win_h - 24, 14, p.ink_soft)  // tray.odin:43-44: x0 := (f32(v.win_w) - total_w) / 2; return {x0 + …, f32(v.win_h) - TRAY_CHIP_H - 10, TRAY_CHIP_W, TRAY_CHIP_H}
detail: Violates briefing "Clamp a minimum window size so HUD can't collapse" + "HUD must remain readable + not overlap". Tray = 6 chips (3 tiers + 3 junction types) = 616px, right edge win_w/2+308; at 1152 that is 884 while the label starts at 832 in the same y-band (tray 612-638, label 624-638) — 52px of text over the last chip.
recommended_fix: Anchor the mode label right-aligned (x = win_w - 12 - text_width) or move it above the tray band; recheck the nudge at win_h-44 which clips the tray top by 6px.

title: Pause-chip two-line threshold (104px) is below the hint's real rendered width (~121px) — hint crosses onto the weather card for widths 1208-1238px
evidence:
if avail >= 104 {
				draw_text(&app, "P/Space to resume", i32(chip.x) + 8, i32(chip.y) + 21, 12, p.ink_soft)
detail: Code claims "the hint needs ~98px + padding — measured"; measured (bundled TTF, 12px + spacing 1) it is ~121px. Hint end = win_w/2+369 vs forecast card left = win_w-250: overlaps for win_w in [1208,1238), and overhangs the 120px-capped chip border at every two-line size. PR body "never overlaps … the weather report" was seam-verified only at 1280/1600/1152/1280×800.
recommended_fix: Raise the two-line threshold to avail >= ~130 (hint 8+121 + margin), or shorten the hint ("P to resume") so it fits the 120px chip cap.

title: Font load is cwd-relative with a silent GetFontDefault fallback — the app launched from a non-root cwd silently reverts to the illegible default font
detail: Violates AC "when it launches, then HUD text renders in the bundled font" for any non-root cwd (e.g. double-clicked app.bin): silent fallback to the exact font the user reported as illegible, zero diagnostics. Unlike the palette (#load-embedded, palette.odin:54) this is a runtime file read; harness.sh cds to root so only the app is exposed.
recommended_fix: Embed the TTF via #load and load with rl.LoadFontFromMemory (the palette's embed pattern), or resolve FONT_ASSET against rl.GetApplicationDirectory(); at minimum TraceLog loudly on fallback.
